---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## What problem does this solve?

Describe the gap or pain point this addresses. Prefer describing the problem
over prescribing the exact solution — there may be a simpler fix.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen. If it touches the system's shape
(architecture, data model, a new agent), a short sketch is more useful than
a fully worked design — that's what an ADR discussion is for.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you didn't propose them instead.

## Which area does this touch?

- [ ] An agent / the orchestration graph
- [ ] Learner model / CEFR estimation
- [ ] Evaluation / grammar correction quality
- [ ] Language packs (new language, new resource type)
- [ ] LLM providers / cost / reliability
- [ ] Privacy / security
- [ ] API / CLI
- [ ] Frontend (Gradio or React)
- [ ] Docs / developer experience
- [ ] Other

## Additional context

Anything else — links to research, related issues, examples from other
tools.
